channel.title: SnapView Updates
channel.description: Product updates, release notes, and support information for SnapView, a fast Mac photo viewer for RAW files and image review.

item.title: SnapView Download Options
item.description: Get SnapView 3.0 and future updates from the Mac App Store, or download the final SnapView 2.7.1 DMG release.

item.title: SnapView Features
item.description: Explore SnapView features for RAW browsing, ZIP review, Pro Layout View, Quick Organize, Batch Actions, Map Overlay, and Quick Check.

item.title: SnapView v2.7.1 Distribution Update
item.description: SnapView 2.7.1 is the final DMG release. SnapView 3.0 and all future updates will be available through the Mac App Store.

item.title: SnapView User Manual
item.description: Learn how to install, browse, compare, rate, and organize photos in SnapView for Mac.

item.title: SnapView Support
item.description: Get SnapView support and learn about the final DMG 2.7.1 release and the move to Mac App Store distribution starting with SnapView 3.0.
